feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.

entry.title: Does Europe regret its bet on U.S. defense?
entry.summary: Europe bet big on American defense technology and they're now paying the price. Years-long backlogs are underway due to production delays and the U.S. own military needs.

entry.title: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
entry.summary: As it races to develop its new massive rocket, the space launch company is preparing to retire NASA's main ride to the International Space Station.

entry.title: A negative Outlook: Microsoft scrambles to fix email outage
entry.summary: Early Friday, after Outlook had been down for more than 12 hours, Microsoft reported "marginal success."

entry.title: CEO Jensen Huang resigns from chip giant Nvidia
entry.summary: The chip giant Nvidia announced that CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down following allegations that he'd had extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

entry.title: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
entry.summary: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.

entry.title: Jensen Huang biographer reacts to the Nvidia CEO's resignation
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Stephen Witt, author of a Jensen Huang biography, about his resignation from his role as CEO of Nvidia.

entry.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
entry.summary: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.

entry.title: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
entry.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?

entry.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
entry.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.
